meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求复查刚完成的开发工作时,它会同时启动 5 个后台小助手,分别核对目标是否达成、代码是否规范、是否安全、能否实际运行,以及有没有遗漏背景信息。5 个全部通过才算通过,任一失败则整体标记为失败。
howto.when: 在把代码提交为 PR 之前,或当你明确要求复查已完成的工作时触发。例如你说出“review work”“review my work”“review changes”等触发词时。

say.text: 请复查我完成的工作(review my work)
say.note: 会启动 5 个子代理并行检查。

say.text: 验证一下刚才的实现(verify implementation)
say.note: 重点核对目标是否达成。

say.text: QA 一下我的改动(QA my work)
say.note: 会实际运行应用来测试行为。

howto.what_en: When asked to review completed work, it launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: goal verification, code quality, security, hands-on QA, and context mining. All must pass; any failure fails the whole review.
howto.when_en: Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Trigger phrases include 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', etc.

say_en.text: Verify the implementation I just finished.
say_en.note: Focuses on whether the goal was met.
Runs the app hands-on to test behavior.
